title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: the Location list changes with the as-of date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has open documents in this report at your current location and location B on today's date.
  • Pick an earlier date, date A, on which location B had no open documents in this report.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to date A.
  2. Click the Location chip and read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report reloads for date A.

Step 2:

  • The list changes with the as-of date: location B is no longer offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R3: “The list offers every location at which the organization has open documents in this report on the as-of date, whatever location the user is signed into and whatever locations they are enrolled in. It is not narrowed by the Location filter, the customer or vendor filter, or the Past due filter; it changes only with the as-of date.”
